versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected between versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.

Initial release of Healthcare Compliance Auditor.

- Covers assessment against HIPAA, HITECH, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, state privacy laws, and emerging AI-in-healthcare regulations.
- Includes checklists for privacy, security, electronic records, AI/ML compliance, and interoperability.
- Provides domain-based risk scoring and standardized reporting template.
- Outlines cost benchmarks for common non-compliance events.
- Supports remediation planning timelines and industry resource links.
